pages.title: Projects
pages.one: A big idea becomes a planned run. You press Start; you judge each stage.

steps.text: Drafts and polishes the plan, asks what is unclear
Proposes the whole run: stages, time, cost
Start, Change it or Not now
steps.detail: Only your Start counts, and only for exactly that proposal.

steps.text: Runs stage by stage with a crew of helpers
At each stop: Continue, Send back or Ship it

good: Autopilot lets the helper decide routine choices for a while; shipping, scope, budget and anything that cannot be undone always come to you.
